en: The postcard is a sepia-toned photograph showing a public park with two prominent monuments—a large statue on a pedestal in the distance, and a bust of a man on a high plinth in the foreground. The park is landscaped with trees, benches, and mountains are visible in the background. A woman in early 20th-century attire is walking near the central statue. There appears to be no visible text or title on the front image.
